title: Principal Frontend Developer
full_description:
In line with ING's strategic goal to provide an exceptional experience to customers globally, ING Hubs network enhances efficiency and digitalization throughout ING. Offering specialized expertise and scalable, sustainable solutions, ING Hubs are dedicated to straight-through processing and provide services such assoftware development, data management, and retail operations.
ING Hubs are present in Poland, Romania, Slovakia, the Philippines, and Turkey, employing a significant workforce. Our employees are connected to the world! As an integral part of ING, we understand ING specifics and operate within the ING culture and frameworks.
Discover ING Hubs Turkiye
ING Hubs Turkiye is looking for talents to join an international network of professionals. Building on an existing framework and shared mission, our up-and-coming team will bring its unique personality and skills set to provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities.
At ING Hubs Turkiye we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest detail. Check out what is waiting for you;
At our organization, you first be yourself, then you are ING’er, therefore;
14 days of welcome leave dayseven in your first year! Don’t postpone your dreams!
With our Flexi Hybrid working model, we are connected to each other remotely on the third week of the months. 💻
Flexible working models where you can manage your time and do your thing.
Discover yourself by taking part in ING projects or career opportunities abroad while working with ING Global! 🌐
We care your health; comprehensive health insurance package for you and your beloved ones (spouse/children)
Private Pension plan for your future dreams.
We provide self-driven career opportunities.
We've partnered with Udemy to expand the learning opportunities available to you. 💡
Develop skills you care about, with training budget.
An informal, dynamic environment with innovative colleagues supporting your endeavors.
Share your innovation ideas while discovering PACE methodology.
Have fun with various communication activities & celebrations. 🥳
6+ years of experience on frontend development
Strong knowledge of JavaScript, HTML and CSS
W3C Standards and features
Critical attention to detail about code, efficiency, and design
Experience writing unit tests, TDD, BDD, familiar with tools like (e.g. Mocha, karma, Chai, Sinon)
Understands deeply about the modern web platform, especially web components, progressive web apps
Experience with at least one modern JavaScript framework (e.g. React, Angular, Vue.js, Svelte) and a solid understanding of its core principles;
Meet service levels for systems (availability, security, and performance)
Experience with Lit Element is a plus
Working with Azure pipelines for CI/CD.
Mentor & coach other developers in their learning & development
Be able to work alone or with others as needs dictate
Communication (written/verbal) to be well developed and of a professional standard
You will be responsible for shaping the technical vision of the platform
Implement new technologies without a negative customer impact.
Integrate clients on to our chosen target platform
If you want to do your thing and explore the life while working don’t miss this opportunity!
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
